statement: For v>0, rho in [-1,1], xi>0, two parallel edges with jointly centered Gaussian log fields X,Y of variance v and covariance rho*v have E[log min(exp(xi*X),exp(xi*Y))]=-xi*sqrt(v*(1-rho)/pi), although each fixed edge has centered log length.
assumptions: Joint Gaussian law with the stated covariance
proof_or_counterexample: min(X,Y)=(X+Y-|X-Y|)/2 and X-Y is Gaussian of variance 2v(1-rho). Integrating E|N(0,sigma^2)| gives the displayed value, including rho=1 by degeneracy.
remaining_gap: Independent check pending. This is an elementary graph counterexample, not an LQG metric or a refutation of a dimension conjecture.

statement: Fix xi,kappa>0, epsilon_n=exp(-n), m_n=ceil(exp(kappa*n)), and m_n parallel unit edges. Identical N(0,n) one-edge marginals and identical constant-shift scaling allow different crossing-normalization exponents: xi*sqrt(2*kappa) for independent edge fields and 0 for perfectly common fields.
assumptions: Within each n the first model has independent Gaussian fields
The second model has one common Gaussian field
Geometry is the specified growing parallel-edge graph
Median crossing normalizer; no independence across n is needed
proof_or_counterexample: Gaussian union-bound and density lower-bound tails give min_i X_{n,i}/n -> -sqrt(2*kappa) in probability. Common Z_n/n -> 0 by Chebyshev. Convergence in probability to a constant passes to all medians after the monotone log transform.
remaining_gap: Independent check pending. Actual GFF covariance, planar crossing geometry and LQG locality are absent from this toy model; the full dimension remains unproved.

statement: On the genuine subcritical LQG branch, if the LFPP median exponent chi(xi) is explicitly known and q=(1-chi(xi))/xi>2, then gamma=q-sqrt(q*q-4) is the root in (0,2) and d_gamma=gamma/xi. This does not evaluate chi or identify a branch for an arbitrary guessed xi.
assumptions: xi is on the actual subcritical LQG branch

source.quote: the exact relationship between Q and xi is not known

proof_or_counterexample: Combine chi=1-xi*Q with gamma^2-2*q*gamma+4=0; the plus root exceeds 2, so choose the minus root. Divide gamma by the actual xi.
remaining_gap: Exact GFF crossing exponent and, for any guessed candidate xi, a valid branch identification. Critical gamma=2 is outside this row.

statement: For two finite Gaussian exponential path lengths with covariance C positive semidefinite, V=max C_ii, covariance gap R=(w1-w2)^T C(w1-w2), gap Delta=f1-f2 and weighted gap measure nu(A)=E[R*1{Delta in A}], assume nu has local density b on (-eta,eta), eta>0, with |b(t)-b(0)|<=L|t|. Then for beta>0, |beta E B_beta-b(0)| <= 2 log(2)L/beta + (4 beta V+2 b(0))*exp(-beta eta).
assumptions: xi>0; two nonzero nonnegative finite coefficient vectors
C positive semidefinite; w are normalized exponential path weights
Local absolute continuity and stated Lipschitz bound for the weighted gap measure
proof_or_counterexample: The pair soft weight is the logistic approximate-identity kernel. Its total mass is one, first absolute moment 2 log(2)/beta and tail mass 2/(1+exp(beta eta)); R<=4V. Integrate the local density error and bound all outside mass, including boundary atoms.
remaining_gap: Uniform cutoff-dependent gap-density bounds, convergence of b_n(0)/T_n, within-path occupation response and multi-route competitiveness remain unproved for LFPP.

statement: For independent standard normal Z,U,V0, xi>0 and M>=0, three parallel edges with log lengths xi(Z+U), xi(Z-U), -M+xi V0 have positive definite field covariance diag(2,2,1). The pair 1,2 switching contribution in the full soft minimum tends to [2/(xi sqrt(2pi))]*Phi(-M/(xi sqrt(2))), whereas its isolated two-route value is 2/(xi sqrt(2pi)).
assumptions: The full soft weights include all three routes
The third base length is exp(-M)>0
xi is fixed; beta tends to infinity
proof_or_counterexample: Transform t=2 beta xi U in the expectation. A logistic integrable majorant allows dominated convergence; the pair survives only when the third route is longer at its tie, V0-Z>M/xi, whose probability is the displayed normal tail.
remaining_gap: Finite model only. Refutes an unqualified isolated-pair replacement, not w516 L1-L5 or any LQG dimension formula.
